recommendation: For the successor history experiment, prefer a global all-row/all-feature H18 sign reversal to complete H18 zeroing. Keep the currently running direct E18-zero campaign unchanged.
reasons: In the pinned bias-free, no-cache Qwen suffix, an all-query zero residual is an ideal absorbing state. Its regenerated H27 is therefore zero: direct-zero versus coherent-zero mostly compares removal of one selected conditioning slice against removal of two, rather than a rich history transformation.

Negating a finite BF16 H18 preserves each absolute value and its norm without an interpolation/rounding dose ambiguity. The sign change avoids the absorbing zero while yielding a specific algebraic prediction about the first suffix block.

This remains a large imposed state perturbation: its FP64 displacement is−2H18 with norm2||H18|| and cosine−1. Norm preservation does not make it on-manifold, small, semantic, or an isolated MLP ablation.

pinned_source_findings.attention: Q/K/V/output linears have config.attention_bias=False; Q/K per-head normalization is multiplicative RMSNorm; rotary position is multiplicative/rotational, without additive position injection.
pinned_source_findings.residual: Qwen is serial: attention residual addition, post-attention RMSNorm, then MLP residual addition. Do not import the FLUX single-block parallel-writer interpretation.
pinned_source_findings.indexing: H18 is the residual after block17 and incoming to zero-indexed block18. Regenerate blocks18..26 to obtain H19..H27.
pinned_source_findings.cache: Require use_cache=False and no unflipped previous KV cache. The global symmetry is not a cached one-token statement.

ideal_math.variables: Let h=H18, R(h)=h+A(N1(h)), x=N2(R(h)), G=Wg x, U=Wu x, M(x)=Wd[SiLU(G)⊙U], Y=R+M.
ideal_math.odd_prefix: For the same complete mask/positions and real arithmetic: RMSNorm(−h)=−RMSNorm(h); Q,K,V all reverse; QK^T and softmax probabilities are unchanged; attention and first residual are odd; x(−h)=−x(h). Epsilon and learned multiplicative RMS weights do not break this oddness.
ideal_math.identity: SiLU(−G)=SiLU(G)−G. Hence M(−x)=−M(x)+Wd[G⊙U], so M(−x)+M(x)=Wd[G⊙U]. Consequently Y(−h)+Y(h)=Wd[G⊙U] for the complete first suffix block in real arithmetic.
ideal_math.scope: The first ideal non-odd activation is SiLU, and the first non-odd residual writer is the MLP. This is not odd symmetry of the entire nine-block recurrence; after block18 its two states generally are no longer negatives.
ideal_math.zero_scope: Zero absorption assumes finite valid inputs and an attention row with permitted keys; signed-zero bits and any nonfinite implementation path remain diagnostics. No native zero suffix has been observed by this review.

finite_precision_qualification: The symbolic identity is not a BF16/GEMM/SDPA equality claim. Preserve original FP32 statistics, BF16 casts/weight products, FP32 RoPE construction/device-only placement, original mask/layout/dispatch and output addition order.
Compare numerical-value antisymmetry and sign-bit antisymmetry separately, especially±0. Do not label signed-zero-only differences as the same scientific effect as nonzero-value differences.
Q/K score invariance is an ideal argument. Actual positioned Q/K/V and head/projection oddness must be measured; do not assume identical softmax/kernel internals from matching source labels.

If earlier finite attention/residual/postnorm steps violate oddness, the later MLP even response includes changed incoming operands as well as SiLU's algebra. Do not assign all observed H19 non-oddness solely to SwiGLU.

Given saved finite R±,M±,Y±, define epsilon±=FP64(Y±)−FP64(R±)−FP64(M±). Then the exact coordinate account is FP64(Y+)+FP64(Y−)=(R++R−)+(M++M−)+(epsilon++epsilon−). Retain signed cross terms for energies; no additive causal percentages.

A posthoc Wd(G⊙U) reconstruction from observed operands is a diagnostic, not a prospective forecast. If any extra learned primitive is executed for that RHS, count it explicitly and declare its rounding profile. Do not add an expensive full FP64 matrix recurrence merely to illustrate the real-arithmetic identity.
row_and_feature_restrictions: Flip every feature of all512 query rows, including padded rows. Padded keys are masked, but their query outputs are still computed and later consumed by FLUX.
Partial token flips generally reverse cross-group QK products and change attention probabilities. Even flipping only attended rows loses whole-state oddness at unflipped padded queries.
Featurewise sign masks generally do not commute with the learned Q/K/V matrices and RMS/QK formation. They answer a different mechanism question; do not apply this global-sign proof to them.
Preserve all shapes, strides, dtype, device and mask/position bytes. Negate by the declared native sign operation, not a nominal interpolated dose.

one_bounded_design.local_comparisons: For block18 retain h±, first norm, positioned Q/K/V, actual head, projection, R±, second norm x±, gate/up, activated product, M± and Y±. First compare oddness defects before interpreting the first MLP even contribution. Retain existing whole signed future comparison rather than a semantic scalar.
one_bounded_design.continuation: The two complete image futures test the mediated H27 route conditional on the same negative E18. They do not estimate a direct×mediated interaction; that requires a fourth E27-only arm plus baseline and is outside this minimum panel.
